goal: ingest/xmlfeed.py reads only <product> elements (stdlib ElementTree; skips the <summary> total line, unescapes & and unicode for free); registered in ingest/__init__.py READERS, config/defaults.py ENABLED_SOURCES, normalize/fields.py FIELD_MAPS (price_unit "minor" since Northwind prices are already cents), cli/main.py USAGE string, README.md sources line

ingest/xmlfeed.py reads only <product> elements, in the order they appear in the feed, with the stdlib ElementTree, so the <summary> day-total line never becomes a record; & comes through as a plain & and accented or Chinese text comes through unchanged. An empty feed, whether a file with nothing in it or a <feed> with no products in it, gives an empty list and a clean exit, never an error or a traceback. A product missing its code, desc or price is passed on for normalize to skip, and the rest of the feed still loads. Registered in ingest/__init__.py READERS, config/defaults.py ENABLED_SOURCES, normalize/fields.py FIELD_MAPS (price_unit "minor", because Northwind prices are already cents: 1299 is 12.99 pounds), the cli/main.py USAGE string and the README.md sources line. It is the same load command with --source xml, no second command or entry point. The XML reader does no price filtering of its own. Nothing in vendor/, normalize/money.py, legacy/, scripts/, ingest/csvfeed.py or tests/test_contract.py changes, and csv and json output stays byte for byte what it is today.
